entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, my agent ID is 301. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I'm calling about my VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. I'd like to start a return for it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the device or more of a preference?
It's definitely a preference. To be honest, I just changed my mind. It works fine, but it was a bit of an impulse buy and I've come to realize I just don't use it enough to justify keeping it.
I see. Thank you for that clarity. Let me just pull up your account details to check the policy. Do you have the order number handy?
Great, one moment... Okay, I see the order. The VeloBand Pulse was delivered on December 26th, about 25 days ago. Let me just check our return eligibility.

Alright, I've consulted our knowledge base. It looks like all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you're only on day 25, you are well within that window. I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund.

Oh, that's fantastic news! I was worried I might have missed the cutoff. I really appreciate that. Since I'm a VIP member and plan on buying another VeloFit product, is there any chance you could offer a discount code or a small bonus if I take it as store credit instead of a refund?

That's an excellent question. And yes, I can see your VIP status here. Instead of a standard refund, I can definitely issue you a store credit for the full purchase price, and as a thank you for your loyalty, I can add a 15% bonus credit on top of that. How does that sound?
That's perfect! It saves me from having to try the resale market or something like that. I'll happily take the bonus store credit. Thank you so much, Isaac.

You're very welcome. I'm happy we found a solution that works better for you. I have just processed that. You'll receive an email shortly with your prepaid return label, and a second email with your VeloFit store credit code. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
